summary: Google DeepMind published results from a randomized controlled trial in Sierra Leone measuring how Gemini's 'Guided Learning' feature affected math learning outcomes for junior secondary students, and released a teacher training guide and RCT playbook.

practices.reason: The document describes a pedagogically-tuned interaction design (scaffolding over direct answers) with measured behavioral outcomes that an engineering team building tutoring or guided-assistant products could draw on.
practices.quote: ’s built from years of research and work in our LearnLM efforts to be pedagogically-grounded and specifically tuned to prioritize building understanding over providing direct answers.
